title: Track an order
body: Customers can track any order from the Orders page. A tracking link is emailed as soon as the order ships, and carrier updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after the label is created.

title: Delivery is late
body: Use when the customer says their order has not arrived yet and the expected delivery date has passed. If an order is more than three business days past its estimated delivery date, open a carrier trace. After seven days, offer a free expedited replacement or a full refund.

title: Package marked delivered but not received
body: Ask the customer to check with neighbours, building reception and safe places, and wait 48 hours because carriers sometimes scan early. After that, file a missing package claim and ship a replacement.

title: Change the shipping address
body: The delivery address can be changed from the Orders page until the order ships. After it ships, the customer can request a redirect through the carrier's tracking page.

title: Cancel an order
body: Orders can be cancelled from the Orders page until they leave the warehouse. If the order has already shipped, the customer can refuse delivery or return it for a full refund.

title: Item arrived damaged
body: Use for shipping damage, when a product arrives broken, cracked or dented. If a product arrives broken or the box is crushed, ask for photos within seven days of delivery. Ship a free replacement right away; the customer does not need to return the damaged item.

title: Received the wrong item
body: If the customer received a different product, model or colour than they ordered, ship the correct item immediately and email a prepaid label to return the wrong one.

title: Part of the order is missing
body: Use when one item from an order never arrived but the rest did. Large orders often ship in several boxes on different days. Check the shipment count on the order. If everything is delivered and an item is still missing, ship the missing item at no charge.

title: Express and next-day delivery
body: Next-day delivery is available for orders placed before 2 PM local time on business days for 14.99 dollars. Express two-day shipping costs 7.99 dollars and is free for Rewards members.

title: International shipping, duties and customs
body: Use when a courier asks the customer to pay import fees, customs or duties on an international delivery. Fabrikam ships to 30 countries. Import duties and customs fees are not included in the price and are collected by the carrier at delivery.

title: Pre-orders and release dates
body: Pre-ordered products ship on the release date. The card is charged only when the item ships, and customers can cancel a pre-order at any time before then.

title: Back-ordered items
body: When an item is back-ordered, the estimated restock date is shown on the order. The customer is not charged until it ships and can cancel at any time.

title: Buy online, pick up in store
body: Customers receive an email when an in-store pickup order is ready. Bring photo ID and the order number. Pickup orders are held for seven days before being cancelled and refunded.

title: Sending an order as a gift
body: Customers can ship to a different address and add a gift message and gift receipt at checkout. Prices are hidden on the packing slip for gift orders.

title: Order confirmation email not received
body: Confirmation emails can take up to 30 minutes and sometimes land in spam or promotions folders. The order is always visible on the Orders page if payment went through.

title: Return policy and return window
body: Most products can be returned within 30 days of delivery in their original packaging for a full refund. Laptops, phones and cameras must be returned within 15 days.

title: How to start a return
body: Start a return from the Orders page by selecting the item and a reason. A prepaid shipping label and QR code are emailed immediately. Drop the package at any carrier location.

title: When will I get my refund
body: Refunds are issued within two business days after the warehouse receives the return. Banks then take three to five business days to show the credit on the statement.

title: Returning a gift or an item without a receipt
body: Gifts can be returned with the gift receipt or order number. Without either, we can look up the purchase by the buyer's email or offer store credit at the lowest recent price.

title: Restocking fee for opened electronics
body: Opened laptops, cameras and drones carry a 15 percent restocking fee unless the item is defective. Unopened items and accessories have no restocking fee.

title: Exchange for a different size, colour or model
body: To exchange, start a return and choose Exchange. The new item ships as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier, and any price difference is charged or refunded.

title: Holiday extended returns
body: Items bought between November 1 and December 31 can be returned until January 31 of the following year.

title: Who pays for return shipping
body: Return shipping is free for defective, damaged or incorrect items. For change-of-mind returns, a 7.99 dollar return shipping fee is deducted from the refund unless the customer is a Rewards member.

title: Refund to an expired or closed card
body: Refunds always go back to the original payment method. If that card was closed or replaced, the bank still applies the credit to the account; otherwise we can issue a gift card.

title: Return an online order in a store
body: Online orders can be returned at any Fabrikam store. Bring the item and the order confirmation. The refund is processed immediately at the counter.

title: Items that cannot be returned
body: Gift cards, digital downloads, software activation codes and opened in-ear headphones for hygiene reasons cannot be returned unless defective.

title: Price dropped after I bought it
body: If the price drops within 14 days of purchase, we refund the difference as a price adjustment. We also match the price of major retailers for identical in-stock items.

title: Return label expired or lost
body: Return labels are valid for 14 days. If the label expired or was lost, reissue a new one from the original return in the agent console at no cost.

title: Return delivered to warehouse but no refund yet
body: If tracking shows the return was delivered more than five business days ago but no refund was issued, escalate to the returns team with the tracking number for a manual refund.

title: Trade in an old device
body: Customers can trade in old phones, laptops and tablets for Fabrikam credit. Get a quote online, ship the device with the free kit, and credit is issued after inspection.

title: Charged twice for one order
body: A second pending charge is usually a temporary card authorization that drops off within three to five business days. If two charges have both posted, refund the duplicate immediately.

title: Payment declined at checkout
body: Declines usually come from the bank, a billing address mismatch or a daily limit. Ask the customer to confirm the billing address and contact their bank, or try another payment method.

title: Accepted payment methods
body: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Fabrikam gift cards and Fabrikam Pay financing.

title: Pay monthly with Fabrikam Pay financing
body: Use when a customer wants to spread the cost over monthly payments instead of paying all at once. Fabrikam Pay offers 0 percent interest for 12 months on purchases over 300 dollars, subject to credit approval. Customers apply at checkout and get a decision in seconds.

title: Promo code not working
body: Check the code's expiry date, minimum spend and excluded brands. Only one promo code can be used per order. If the code was valid, apply the discount as a refund after purchase.

title: Sales tax and tax-exempt purchases
body: Sales tax is calculated from the shipping address. Tax-exempt organizations must upload their exemption certificate to their business account before ordering.

title: Invoices and VAT receipts for business
body: Itemized invoices with company name and VAT number can be downloaded from the Orders page. Business details can be added to an invoice after purchase.

title: Gift card balance and redemption
body: Check a gift card balance on the gift card page or at checkout. Gift cards never expire, can be combined with other payment methods and cannot be exchanged for cash.

title: Charge the customer does not recognize
body: Look up the charge by amount and date. It is often a split shipment, a subscription renewal or a family member's order. If it is still unknown, freeze the account and open a dispute.

title: Update the card on file
body: Customers can add, remove or change saved cards and the default billing address in Account settings under Payment methods.

title: Fabrikam Care+ monthly subscription charges
body: Care+ monthly plans renew automatically on the purchase date each month. The charge appears as FABRIKAM CARE PLUS on statements.

title: Student, teacher and military discounts
body: Verified students, teachers and military members get 10 percent off laptops and tablets. Verification takes a few minutes through our partner and the discount applies at checkout.

title: Split payment across two cards
body: Online orders can be paid with one card plus gift cards. Splitting between two credit cards is only possible in store.

title: Business accounts and net-30 invoicing
body: Registered business customers can apply for net-30 payment terms and a credit limit. Approval takes two business days and invoices are emailed monthly.

title: Financing payment is due
body: Fabrikam Pay statements are emailed monthly. Customers can pay online, set up autopay or change the due date once per year in their Fabrikam Pay account.

title: Reset a forgotten password
body: Customers can reset their password from the sign-in page with Forgot password. The reset link is valid for one hour; ask them to check spam if it does not arrive.

title: Account locked after too many sign-in attempts
body: After five failed attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. Agents can unlock it immediately after verifying the customer's identity with the last order number.

title: Change the email address on the account
body: The sign-in email can be changed in Account settings. A confirmation link is sent to the new address, and the old address receives a notification.

title: Close or delete an account
body: Customers can request account deletion in Privacy settings. Open orders and returns must be completed first. Data is deleted within 30 days, except records we must keep by law.

title: Verification code not arriving
body: If the two-step verification text does not arrive, check the phone number on file, wait one minute and request a new code, or switch to email or authenticator app codes.

title: Stop marketing emails
body: Use the unsubscribe link in any marketing email or turn off promotions in Communication preferences. Order and delivery emails will still be sent.

title: Merge two accounts
body: Accounts cannot be merged automatically. Agents can move order history and Rewards points from a duplicate account to the main one after verifying both email addresses.

title: Rewards points balance and expiry
body: Rewards members earn 5 points per dollar. Points appear 30 days after purchase, can be redeemed as certificates, and expire after 12 months without activity.

title: Rewards points missing from a purchase
body: Points are added 30 days after purchase once the return window closes. If points are still missing after that, add them manually using the order number.

title: Guest order not showing in account
body: Orders placed as a guest can be linked to an account if they used the same email address. Use Link a guest order in Account settings with the order number.

title: Update phone number
body: Change the mobile number in Account settings under Security. The new number receives a verification code before it is saved.

title: Price alerts and wish lists
body: Customers can save products to a wish list and turn on price alerts to get an email when an item goes on sale or is back in stock.

title: Text message delivery updates
body: Customers can turn on SMS notifications for shipping and delivery updates in Communication preferences. Standard message rates apply.

title: Change the name on the account
body: The account holder's name can be updated in Account settings. Name changes on Fabrikam Pay financing require identity verification.

title: Fabrikam Rewards membership tiers
body: Rewards has two tiers. Plus members, who spend over 1,500 dollars a year, get free express shipping, free returns and early access to sales.

title: Laptop will not turn on
body: Connect the original charger and check that the charging light comes on. Hold the power button for 30 seconds to reset, then press it once. If nothing happens, start a repair.

title: Battery drains too fast
body: Check battery usage by app in Settings, lower screen brightness, turn on battery saver and install the latest updates. Batteries holding less than 80 percent capacity in the first year qualify for replacement.

title: Wireless earbuds will not pair
body: Put the earbuds in the case, hold the case button for 10 seconds until the light flashes white, then remove the old pairing on the phone and pair again from Bluetooth settings.

title: Sound only in one earbud
body: Clean the charging contacts in the case, check the audio balance setting on the phone and reset the earbuds. If one side still has no sound, start a warranty replacement.

title: Smart speaker will not connect to Wi-Fi
body: Smart speakers only work on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Move the speaker closer to the router, restart both, and run setup again from the Fabrikam Home app.

title: TV shows no signal
body: Check that the TV input matches the HDMI port in use, try a different HDMI cable and port, and power cycle both the TV and the connected device.

title: Smartwatch not syncing with phone
body: Make sure Bluetooth is on and the Fabrikam Fit app is allowed to run in the background. Restart the watch and phone, and unpair and re-pair the watch if syncing still fails.

title: Printer shows as offline
body: Restart the printer and router, confirm the printer is on the same Wi-Fi network as the computer, then remove and re-add the printer in Settings.

title: Laptop is overheating or the fan is loud
body: Use the laptop on a hard flat surface, close heavy apps, update the BIOS and drivers, and use the balanced power mode. Persistent overheating can be inspected at a Tech Bar.

title: Screen flickering
body: Update the graphics driver, change the refresh rate in display settings and test with an external monitor. Flickering on the built-in screen only usually needs a repair.

title: Setting up a new Windows PC
body: Walk the customer through signing in with a Microsoft account, running Windows Update and installing apps. Fabrikam Tech Bar also offers paid setup with data transfer.

title: Transfer files from an old computer
body: Customers can use OneDrive backup or an external drive to move files to a new PC. The Fabrikam data transfer service moves files and settings for 49 dollars.

title: Smart thermostat is not heating
body: Check that the thermostat is set to Heat mode, the schedule is correct and the wiring C-wire is connected. Restart it from the Fabrikam Home app and check the furnace breaker.

title: Game controller stick drift
body: Recalibrate the controller in console settings and update its firmware. If the stick still moves on its own, the controller qualifies for a warranty replacement.

title: Camera photos are blurry
body: Clean the lens, turn on image stabilization, use a faster shutter speed and update the camera firmware. If autofocus still fails, send the camera for service.

title: Standard manufacturer warranty
body: All new products include a one-year manufacturer warranty against defects. Accidental damage such as drops and spills is not covered by the standard warranty.

title: What Fabrikam Care+ covers
body: Care+ extends coverage up to three years and adds accidental damage from drops, spills and cracked screens, with 24/7 expert support and no deductible for the first claim.

title: File a Care+ claim for a cracked screen
body: Customers can file a Care+ claim online with a photo of the damage. Approved screen repairs are completed in store the same day or by mail-in within five days.

title: Check repair status
body: Use when a customer sent a device in for repair and asks for an update. Repair status is shown on the Repairs page with the repair number. Customers get email updates when the device is received, repaired and shipped back.

title: Mail-in repair process
body: We email a prepaid box and label. Back up and remove passwords from the device before shipping. Most mail-in repairs are returned within seven to ten business days.

title: Water and liquid damage
body: Liquid damage is not covered by the standard warranty but is covered by Care+. Ask the customer to power the device off and not charge it until it is inspected.

title: Battery replacement under warranty
body: Batteries are replaced free under warranty if they hold less than 80 percent of original capacity. Out of warranty, battery service is a flat fee of 99 dollars.

title: Transfer a warranty to a new owner
body: Care+ plans can be transferred once to a new owner when the device is sold or gifted. Submit the transfer form with the new owner's email address.

title: Add Care+ after purchase
body: Care+ can be added within 60 days of purchase from the Orders page. After 60 days, the device needs an in-store inspection before coverage can be added.

title: Out-of-warranty repair cost
body: Out-of-warranty repairs start with a 49 dollar diagnostic fee that is credited toward the repair. The customer approves the quote before any work begins.

title: Dead or stuck pixels
body: Laptops and monitors with three or more dead pixels, or any dead pixel in the center of the screen, qualify for a replacement under warranty.

title: Lost or stolen device coverage
body: Care+ with Theft and Loss covers up to two lost or stolen phones per year. The customer needs a police report and must have Find My Device turned on.

title: Repeated repairs and replacement
body: If the same problem needs a third repair within the warranty period, we replace the product with a new one of equal or better specification.

title: Cancel a Care+ plan
body: Care+ can be cancelled at any time. Plans cancelled within 30 days get a full refund; after that, the unused portion is refunded pro rata if no claims were made.

title: Book an in-store Tech Bar appointment
body: Customers can book a Tech Bar appointment online for diagnostics, warranty repairs and setup help. Walk-ins are welcome but appointments get priority.
